macros.name: globalNamedDelim
macros.doc: \globalNamedDelim is the same as \NamedDelim except that the effect of the former has global scope, while the latter is local to a group.

macros.name: named
macros.doc: Starts scanning ahead for prefixes and the definition command.

macros.name: NamedDelim
macros.doc: The package also defines a macro \NamedDelim which allows the user to change the delimiter of the named parameters to their liking.
